readerAnswers.event: Twenty-five recipients of the Fields Medal, a leading mathematics award, published a September 11 declaration.
readerAnswers.limit: This is an attributed argument, not evidence that AI cannot produce correct mathematics or a rule for researchers or students.
readerAnswers.meaning: A correct proof may still require people to identify its useful idea, connect earlier work and explain it.
readerAnswers.action: Try a small two-pass check. First ask the AI for a solution.

terms.benchmark: a defined test used to compare performance on a chosen task

explainBack: The declaration separates producing a correct result from the communal work of identifying, checking, explaining and teaching the useful idea.
unseenTransfer: For any benchmark claim, ask what the selected test measures and whether that is the full result a learner or profession needs.
